title: Three-row infeed, six-row tempering and single-row discharge on a track-shoe press-quenching and tempering line
summary: A Suneng roller-hearth track-shoe line proposal runs from pallet pickup to the buyer's shot-blasting-machine inlet. It includes turning, three-lane heating and press quenching, six-lane tempering and merging into one lane. Interfaces must preserve workpiece orientation, lane assignment and downstream release conditions as well as conveyor elevation.
